text:
Maya Li: Quick idea — 'Sunrise Park Mini-Festival' for next week lunch? Thinking 11:30–1pm, picnic vibes + two short games (trivia & cornhole) + optional 10-min open mic. Who's up? :sun_with_face: Reply with a) which date works (Thu/Fri/any) and b) what snack you can bring.
Ethan Kim: I'm in. Prefer Thu. I can bring a big grain salad and reusable cutlery. Any veg/vegan needs?
Samir Patel: Count me in too. Thu or Fri both fine. I'll bring a bluetooth speaker + extension cable. Also have a folding table and a small cornhole set.
Rini Gomez: Love it. If facilities will cover tables/chairs or a small pizza budget, that would help. Otherwise I'm happy to chip in for paper plates.
Maya Li: Filed a quick request with facilities this morning for picnic table setup and trash pickup. If they nudge back, rooftop fallback at 12:15.
facilities-bot: Request received — #REQ-2026-442. Facilities will review; expect confirmation within 48 hours. Note: outdoor food requires covered trash plan.
Ethan Kim: Thanks — can we have clear labels for allergens? I can bring small cards to label dishes.
Samir Patel: Good call. I'll also bring a small first-aid kit and some hand sanitizer.
Ava (remote): I'm remote that day but would love to do a 10-min virtual improv mini-set around 12:20 for whoever's on video — no pressure. :grinning:
Rini Gomez: Budget question — is there a team petty cash or should org card be used for a couple of party pizzas?
Maya Li: I asked finance for a $75 team event approval as well. If that clears we can order a couple of pies. If not, potluck style.
Ethan Kim: Potluck works. Also prefer non-alcohol event (company policy + all-inclusive). Happy to bring sparkling water and mocktail mixers.
Samir Patel: Can someone start a quick RSVP thread? Maybe a 3-option poll for date: Thu 11:30, Fri 12:00, Either. Simple checkboxes.
Maya Li: Poll below — vote please! 1) Thu 11:30 2) Fri 12:00 3) Either 4) Can't make it
Rini Gomez: Voted 1.
Ethan Kim: Voted 1.
Samir Patel: Voted 1.
Ava (remote): Voted 3 (happy either, will join virtually).
Maya Li: Great — looks like Thu 11:30 is top. I'll finalize once facilities confirms. Anyone want to run trivia? I can prep 10 questions, but volunteer hosts welcome.
Rini Gomez: I can host trivia rounds 1 & 2.
Samir Patel: I'll run scoreboard and prizes (I have some fun stickers).
Ethan Kim: I can bring bingo-style name tags or scoring sheets if helpful.
Maya Li: Amazing. Quick checklist: facilities confirm, finance approve $75 optionally, snacks volunteers list, hosts: Rini (trivia), Samir (score/prizes), Ava remote mini-set. I'll post final logistics by Tue. :raised_hands:
facilities-bot: Update — #REQ-2026-442 approved. Tables and trash pickup scheduled. Please ensure food is in sealed containers and labeled.
Maya Li: Approved! Final call: if you haven't yet, reply with what you'll bring so we don't end up with 5 salads :joy:.
Ethan Kim: Salad + cutlery + allergen labels.
Samir Patel: Speaker + cornhole + folding table + extension cord + stickers (prizes).
Rini Gomez: Plates/napkins and I'll grab two small vegetarian pizzas if finance clears.
Ava (remote): I'll email a 2-minute improv prompt list and join via video at 12:20.
Maya Li: Perfect — thanks team. I'll lock in order logistics and post a reminder on Thu morning with exact spot coordinates and a photo of the setup. :party_popper:
